sentences.en: Barley and wheat grow in the fields around the village.
sentences.zh: 大麦和小麦在村子周围的田野里生长。

sentences.en: Algeria has a huge potential to grow wheat and barley.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚种植小麦和大麦具有巨大的潜力。

sentences.en: Having run the race, Jane had two glasses of barley tea.
sentences.zh: 比赛结束后，简喝了两杯大麦茶。
